allow: PowerShell(python -m pytest tests/test_skeleton.py -k "trace or neighbor or flood" -q)
PowerShell(foreach \($p in 'COM26','COM16','COM17'\) { Write-Output "=== $p ==="; .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe -m meshtools --port $p --quiet info 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 4 })

PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_SerialPort | Where-Object { $_.DeviceID -eq 'COM11' } | Select-Object DeviceID, Description, Name | Format-List; Write-Output "---"; Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'meshcore|arduino|putty|python|node|serial|cu' } | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, MainWindowTitle | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(foreach \($id in 25324,30408\) { try { Stop-Process -Id $id -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output "killed $id" } catch { Write-Output "could not kill ${id}: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 800; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='python.exe'" | Select-Object ProcessId | Format-Table -AutoSize)
